definitions.numbered_topic_directory: A docs/topics directory whose name begins with a numbered research identifier such as 0.1 or 0.21.
definitions.supporting_topic_workspace: A docs/topics directory used for staging or shared support work rather than a numbered research claim.
definitions.verification_script: A topic-level script whose filename begins with Verify_ and is intended to produce reproducible evidence artifacts.
definitions.automated_test_file: A repository Python test file whose filename begins with test_.
definitions.release: A repository snapshot whose metadata must align across README, docs landing pages, package metadata, and citation files.
definitions.golden_result: A checked-in output or artifact selected as the canonical internal reference for a documented run.

restricted_without_explicit_evidence: One Equation to Rule Them All
